Each transaction can have its own specialized line entity, but they should all inherit the same conceptual structure:
That gives us consistency across Sales, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and even Service, while still allowing each transaction type to add fields unique to its workflow.
I think this will make both the database model and the application code much more maintainable as KoreVity grows.
